messages.自分の振動回数を防御レベル増加に変え、挑発値で攻撃を集めながら振動爆発で殴り返す: A tank that converts her Tremor Count into Defense Level Up, draws attacks with Aggro, and strikes back through Tremor Burst.
messages.振動回数→防御レベル増加: 各攻撃スキルは使用時に自分の振動回数に応じて防御レベ: **Tremor Count → Defense Level Up**: Each attack skill grants Defense Level Up on use based on her Tremor Count. The more Defense Level Up she has, the higher their power.
messages.挑発値: S1〜S3は使用時に次のターンの挑発値を得る(S3は8/10)。: **Aggro**: S1–S3 grant Aggro next turn on use (8/10 for S3).
messages.防御態勢: 守備「あなたの盾」の戦闘開始時に得る。次のターン、速度が最低値に固定: **Defensive Stance**: Gained at Combat Start of the Defense skill Your Shield. On the next turn, her Speed is fixed at its minimum, but she gains 5 Defense Level Up, Aggro, Stagger immunity, Tremor Burst on Clash Win, and more. In Focused Encounters, she can redirect attack targets to herself regardless of Speed.
messages.S3「守護」: 防御態勢があればダメージ量+50/70%。Ⅲコインで自分の振動回: **S3 — Ward**: +50/70% damage with Defensive Stance. Coin Ⅲ spends all of her Tremor Count to inflict that much Tremor and trigger Tremor Burst.
messages.パッシブ「衝撃相殺グレートソード」: 戦闘開始時、自分の振動回数だけ防御レベル増: **Passive — Shock-nullifying Greatsword**: At Combat Start, gains Defense Level Up equal to her Tremor Count (up to 5, doubled during Defensive Stance).
messages.守備で防御態勢と振動回数を得て攻撃を集め、防御レベル増加を高く保つ。S3で振動回: Gain Defensive Stance and Tremor Count with her Defense skill to draw attacks and keep Defense Level Up high. Convert Tremor Count into Tremor with S3 and trigger Tremor Burst.
